activity_summary: At the porch you put two shillings of your own into the box and did not speak. A churchwarden named the sum. Mistress Ansell was watching, and she said there had been no show. No name was entered at the dish.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put two shillings in the box and did not speak.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stood by the box, refused a name, and said there was no show.

facets.activity: Put two shillings in the porch box

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: No name. Two shillings is the sum. I am watching, Master Shakespeare, and I have seen no show.
